statements.subject: server
statements.description: Each proxy MUST set up the TLS session to the next hop if not already present (i.e., run the TLS handshake, but do not send the RTSP request).
statements.trigger: RTSP request received and TLS session not yet established
actions: run TLS handshake to next hop

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Check if a matching identity and hash of the peer certificate are present in the Accept-Credentials header. If present, send the message to the next hop and conclude these procedures.
statements.trigger: matching identity and hash found in Accept-Credentials header
actions: forward RTSP request to next hop

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The proxy responds to the RTSP request with a 470 or 407 response code when no matching identity and hash are present in the Accept-Credentials header. The proxy MUST include a Connection-Credentials header with the next hop's identity and certificate.
statements.trigger: no matching identity and hash found in Accept-Credentials header
actions: send 470 or 407 response with Connection-Credentials header

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The client MUST upon receiving a 470 (Connection Authorization Required) or 407 (Proxy Authentication Required) response with Connection-Credentials header take the decision on whether or not to accept the certificate.
statements.trigger: 470 or 407 response with Connection-Credentials header received

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the certificate is accepted, the client has to again send the RTSP request. In that request, the client has to include the Accept-Credentials header including the hash over the DER-encoded certificate for all trusted proxies in the chain.
actions: include Accept-Credentials header with DER-encoded certificate hash for all trusted proxies

statements.subject: message
statements.description: In the 470 or 407 response message the proxy MUST include a Connection-Credentials header with the next hop's identity and certificate.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The client has to include the Accept-Credentials header including the hash over the DER-encoded certificate for all trusted proxies in the chain when resending the RTSP request after accepting the certificate.
